of: A mechanism by which a previously available course of action becomes unexercisable without its holder declining it and without any party at the holder's own table deciding about it, named with the condition lost (a permission, a capability, a counterparty, a coordination), the carrier that runs the clock, and the last intervention that could have kept it, and sorted by what the clock is made of, from clocks the holder never started to clocks the holder's own care for the option started: a closure that must strike before it can be known, a date on someone else's docket, a date on the option's parent, the holder's own development, the record's last witness, the world healing faster than the forum, a ratifier's term, a counterparty's transfer or planning cycle, a coordination's half-life, the holder's own growth, then the act that vests, the exercise that keeps, the readiness that spoils, the move on a neighbouring matter, the new state's first act, the machine that holds the option open, and the pause paper whose renewal belongs to the adversary.
map_register: Operator-grade and concrete: bank holidays and Sunday decrees, bar dates and opt-out postcards, emergency authorizations, eye patches, last-known-well times, mootness and class certification, adjournment sine die, memoranda of lease, reorganizations that absorb a vacancy, sixty-day signatures, approval ceilings, poured footings, empty flights and irrigated fields, thawed vials, first responsive pleadings, first writes, ECMO circuits and mine pumps, tolling agreements; drawn from capital controls, bankruptcy, public-health law, paediatrics, stroke care, constitutional litigation, legislatures, real property, employment, recall elections, mergers, land use, aviation and water law, cold-chain logistics, patent and civil procedure, software migration, transplant medicine, and litigation practice.

items.out: Weekend closure. An authority shuts the exit in the hours the holder cannot act, because announcing the closure would be the signal to use it. Greek banks, Monday 29 June 2015, after a Sunday address. Cyprus, March 2013, a bank holiday extended, after parliament refused the first levy, until the bail-in was law. Argentina, the corralito, a Saturday in December 2001. An export licence suspended, a delisting published, after the fact. Lost: permission, the leave to move what is yours. Carrier: the authority's calendar, set to the holder's shut hours, the Friday night, the bank holiday. Last keep: a transfer on rumour, at the cost of being wrong and of the rumour discount; the deposits that left Greece that spring left on nothing more. The one expiry here whose notice cannot come first. Wait for a date and you wait for what the mechanism forbids. Beside runway-illusions' Cash behind glass, which counts the Friday deposit as owned and unreachable: this is what chose the Friday. Not investor-tells' Let it lapse, a fuse the founder tests by letting it pass; what can be probed need not surprise. Not a withdrawn offer or a rival's foreclosure, decided at the holder's table; a decree rules a class, and nobody at the table decided about the holder. The exit is forbidden by name, not lost as a side effect.

Bar date in the newspaper. The claim ends on a date set in a proceeding the holder does not attend and is deemed to have read. The bankruptcy bar date for proofs of claim, noticed to unknown creditors by publication. The class opt-out date on a postcard that looks like advertising. The probate creditor's window after the notice runs in the county paper. Lost: permission, the standing to be paid or to sue alone. Carrier: the bar-date order and the rule of constructive notice; publication is knowledge for anyone the debtor could not name. Last keep: a one-page proof of claim or a signed opt-out. The cheapest filing in the law and the least made, because the one who would make it is by construction the one not told. Beside runway-illusions' Stamp's clock, a date the holder can read on the stamp: this date is on another's docket and imputed. Not deal-deaths' Missing witness; the record is whole, and only the holder is missing from the room.

Emergency over. The option was granted under a parent instrument with a term of its own. It ends when the parent ends, on no date of its own, whatever its merits. The emergency-use authorization, ended when the declaration it was issued under is terminated; a different paper from the public-health emergency, which ended in May 2023 and left the authorizations standing. The cross-state telehealth licence, lapsed with each state's emergency in 2021 and 2022. The wartime power. The pilot under a waiver. The sub-lease under the head lease. Lost: permission. Carrier: the parent's date, which the holder never signed and may never have read, since the grant it read carried none; the holder must first find which paper carries it. Last keep: conversion. A full approval, a permanent rule, a licence in one's own name, filed while the parent stands. Conversion is slow, so it must start while the emergency looks endless, which is when nobody starts it. Not Bar date in the newspaper: that date is on a docket and imputed; this one is on another paper, and honest. Not lead-time-floors' Calendar with nothing in it, a wait the rule imposes; this rule does not wait. It ends.

Patch before seven. The option ends by the holder's own development, on a schedule the holder cannot know, so the last keep is in another hand. Amblyopia: most correctable by patching the good eye in the first years, less and less completely after about seven, though the trials of the 2000s found response into the early teens. The clubfoot cast in infancy. The second language without an accent, contested as a hard window. The duckling's first day. Lost: a capability, the cortex's willingness to rewire. Carrier: the developmental timetable; the holder is a child who does not know there is an eye to save. Last keep: a screening. The preschool vision check. The parent who notices a squint. The option is one person's; its preservation is another's. Where no programme exists, the option expires unseen at a rate that belongs to the programme, not to the child. Beside Last known well, where a witness dates the option: here the holder cannot be its own witness at all. Not use-it-or-lose-it; nothing the child does or leaves undone runs the clock.

Last known well. The option is dated by the last witness to the fact, not by the fact. It ends when the proof runs out while the body might still allow it. The stroke patient who wakes with the deficit is ineligible for thrombolysis, because the four and a half hours count from when she was last seen well, at bedtime, whenever the artery closed. The opened vial with no time on the label. The sample with a gap in its chain of custody. Each treated as expired at the earliest time it could have been. Lost: a capability, a treatment the protocol now forbids. Carrier: the protocol's timestamp rule, which asks for a witness, not for the tissue. Last keep: a witness. Someone awake. A time on the vial. Or a witness of another kind, the imaging that reads the tissue's own clock, by which the WAKE-UP trial of 2018 returned the drug to patients with no witnessed onset. Beside witness-architectures, which asks what must exist for a trace to form: the option that dies for want of a trace while the fact would still allow it. Not Patch before seven, where the body's clock has run; here the body's may not have, and the record's has.

Mooted. The option to a decision ends because the situation resolves faster than the forum moves. Nobody declines. Nobody rules. The student whose admissions challenge was dismissed as moot because he was about to graduate (DeFunis, 1974). The pregnancy over before the appeal. The election held before the ballot-access case. The tenant evicted before housing court sits. The grievance mooted by the reorganization that abolished the post. Lost: permission, the justiciability of the claim. Carrier: the ratio of the forum's pace to the harm's duration; no party at the table sets it. Last keep: a structure that outlives the individual harm. The class certified before the named plaintiff's harm ends, which Sosna (1975) allowed. The doctrine that a harm capable of repetition yet evading review may be decided anyway, which Roe rested on. The option is kept by a coordination or a rule, never by hurrying. Not deal-deaths' Cost of the last mile, where surplus is eaten on a curve; nothing is eaten, the harm is over. Not Bar date in the newspaper; there is no date anywhere.

Session ends. The body that could have said yes reaches the end of its own term with the matter pending. Its successor never has to say no. Bills that die on adjournment sine die and start again from the beginning. The treaty signed, awaiting a parliament that is dissolved. The permit before a council that is re-elected. The approval agreed in the hallway and not yet minuted when the board was reconstituted at the meeting. The offer approved by a committee disbanded in the reorganization. What ends is the matter's place in the process; the successor starts it at zero. Lost: a counterparty, the specific body whose yes was available. Carrier: the ratifier's own calendar, election, session, term. Last keep: the vote scheduled before adjournment. The carry-over motion. The approval minuted, not agreed in the hallway. The treaty cases are simplified, since most unratified treaties were eventually refused by someone; the clean form is the bill, dying by the thousand each session with no recorded no. Beside deal-deaths' Ratifier's other deal, where the ratifier wanted a different bargain: this ratifier wanted this one and was gone before the vote. Not Landlord changes, where the counterparty is replaced by transfer; here it is replaced by the calendar.

Landlord changes. An option held in a person, not on the paper that transfers, ends at the counterparty's next transfer. The holder does not control it and often does not see it. The renewal promised by the landlord who sells the building to a buyer not bound by unrecorded promises. The 'we'll take you back' from a manager who leaves. The side letter with a fund's partner that the successor manager has never seen. The supplier's verbal priority, gone with the account executive. Lost: a counterparty, the one whose word held the option. Carrier: the register, the deed, the fund agreement, the offer letter on letterhead. The option was never written there, so the successor takes free of it. Last keep: recording. A memorandum of option on the title. A side letter countersigned by the entity. The promise put on the paper that binds successors. The cost is the awkwardness of asking a friendly counterparty to bind their unknown replacement. Beside term-sheet-powers' Successor in the chair, where the replacement exercises a term the friend would not have: the mirror, where the replacement declines a term the friend gave. Not Chair grown over, where the counterparty stays and the shape goes.

Chair grown over. The option to return rests on a vacancy the counterparty has not yet re-planned. It ends at the next planning cycle, and nobody declines the return. The leave with no return date whose post is split among three at the next reorganization. The budget line reallocated at year end. The supplier's line retooled for the customer who stayed. The co-founder's seat the remaining founders stop leaving empty at the next hire. What ends is the return to the seat; employment there afterwards is a new negotiation from outside. Lost: a capability on the counterparty's side, the shape that could receive the holder. Carrier: the counterparty's planning cadence, quarterly, annual, the next reorganization, set without reference to the holder at all. Last keep: a dated return. A leave rather than a resignation. A reservation the cycle must respect. Or the return itself, before the cycle turns. Beside traces-of-the-unlived's Vacancy tenant, where preparation for a future breeds its opponents: here nobody opposes the return; the absence is absorbed. Not forms-of-return's Reentry burn, a road open and hostile one way; this road has closed.

Petition that goes stale. An option that needs many simultaneous yeses ends unless the gathering outruns the decay of each yes. A coordination has a half-life. The recall petition whose signatures older than sixty days are invalid under Michigan's rule, or must all fall within California's hundred and sixty days. The tender offer's minimum condition, to be met by the offer's expiry. The crowd in the square that goes home. The reunion that becomes impossible one death at a time. Lost: a coordination. Carrier: the validity window on each act of assent, written by the rule or by the assenter's own attention. Last keep: a gathering rate. Paid circulators. A date agreed in advance. A pact that binds the early yeses until the last arrives. The recall and tender cases are observed; the crowd is analogy. Beside who-can-be-bound's Place in line, an ordering lost by leaving: here the coordination is lost by others' leaving. Not Session ends, where one body's calendar kills the matter; here many small calendars do.

Outgrown the buyer. The holder's own growth moves the counterparty out of reach. The option to sell to the natural acquirer ends at the round that prices the company above what the acquirer can pay at all: a market capitalization smaller than the price, a wage cap, a fund's concentration limit, and past those a board's approval ceiling. Nobody at either table declines. The company whose preference stack now exceeds the largest deal its three strategic buyers have ever done. The player whose wage outgrows every club in the league but two. The practice too large for any partner to buy in and too small to be listed. Lost: a counterparty, the buyer whose capacity was the option. Carrier: the acquirer's capacity, readable in its market value and its deal history, against the holder's own price, which each round raises. Last keep: the sale at the last price under the ceiling, never seen as the last. Or a round sized to stay under it, the one choice a founder is never advised to make. Analytical: every observed case can be read as a buyer that would have paid more, so this stands as a mechanism, not a count. Beside market-deaths' Slowed past the rot, where a market thins from outside: here the holder thins its own market by growing. Not Chair grown over, where the counterparty re-plans; the counterparty is unchanged, and the holder has left its range.

Pour the foundation. A permission is about to be withdrawn by a third party's rule change. It can be kept only by an act in the world; no paper substitutes. The building that may proceed under the old zoning only if the developer has substantially begun on a valid permit before the ordinance passes, the footings poured the week of the council vote. The nonconforming use that survives the new code only if in use on the effective date. The grandfathered rate kept only by the account that was open. Lost: permission. Carrier: the code and the vested-rights doctrine, which in most states vests on construction begun and in a few, as in Washington, on a complete application. The last act differs by jurisdiction; the holder who knows which has a different week. Last keep: the hole in the ground before the vote. An exercise begun, not a filing made. The option is preserved only by starting to use it. Beside first-mover-forecloses, which holds the rival who changes the rules on purpose: here the rule changes for reasons of its own. Not Slot flown empty, where the exercise must be repeated to keep the right; here one beginning vests it for good.

Slot flown empty. The permission ends by disuse and is kept only by exercise. The clock runs while the holder does nothing and stops when the holder acts. The preserving act is the exercise emptied of its purpose. The airport slot that must be flown eighty percent of the season or returned, which had airlines flying empty aircraft in early 2020 until the rule was waived. The water right under prior appropriation, forfeited after five years without beneficial use, which has fields irrigated in a drought to keep them. The trade mark abandoned after three years' non-use. The mining claim kept by annual labour. The department budget spent in the last quarter so it is not cut. Lost: permission. Carrier: the regulator's usage ledger. Last keep: the empty flight. It costs the whole price of using the option and returns nothing but the option. Keeping and using are one act; the option's upkeep is its exercise price. Beside runway-illusions' Stamp's clock, a licence that lapses without hours logged and that no cash extends: the price at which it can be extended after all, hours flown for nobody. Beside tollgates-that-must-buy's Stamp with an expiry, where the gate must spend its stamp: the holder who must burn the permission to keep it. Beside power-trades' Leased strike, where disuse makes a power unbelieved: the disuse that forfeits it by rule. Not Pour the foundation, one act that vests; here no act ever finishes the keeping.

Thawed to be ready. Preparing to exercise starts a decay the unprepared state did not have. The option to wait ends because the option to act was made ready. The vaccine vial: months frozen, weeks thawed, hours punctured. The epoxy whose pot life begins at mixing. The drawn dose. The armed fuze. The reagent brought to room temperature. The opened surgical field. The reserve army that cannot be held at the frontier through the harvest it was drawn from. Lost: a capability, the good itself spoiling in its ready state. Carrier: a chemistry, or a season, that begins at preparation. Last keep: not preparing, or preparing in the smallest unit. The single-dose vial. The small mix. The tranche thawed for the day's bookings. The clinic that thaws a tray to be sure of serving whoever comes has bought readiness with the doses it will discard at closing. The mirror of Slot flown empty, where the option dies of not being touched; here it dies of being touched. A holder of both must burn the one and refrain from readying the other. Not lead-time-floors' Understudy, a finished copy waiting; the understudy does not spoil for having been rehearsed. Not Kept on the machine, where the harm falls on the holder and is billed by the day; here it falls on the good.

First or never. The option must be taken before any other move on a linked matter. Its clock is the holder's own next act, not a date. Do nothing and keep it; do anything adjacent and lose it. The objection to the court's jurisdiction over the defendant, waived if left out of the first response. The patent dead in Europe on the morning of the conference talk and a year later in the United States. The appeal waived by accepting the settlement. The election of remedies. The defect in the goods that must be objected to before the goods are used. 'Speak now' at the wedding. Lost: permission. Carrier: a rule that binds the option to a position in a sequence. The sequence is written elsewhere than the option, in the rules of procedure, the patent statute, the sales code, so the holder learns the order from the loss. Last keep: the ordering itself. The provisional application filed the morning of the talk. The reservation written into the first filing. The objection lodged before the goods are unpacked. Each costs nothing but the knowledge that an order exists. Not Slot flown empty, where the holder's inaction runs the clock; here inaction is the only thing that keeps it. Not Bar date in the newspaper; there is no date, and only the holder can strike.

Rollback horizon. The option to reverse a move ends at the first act the new state performs that the old state cannot read. The window is the pause between the change and its first consequence. It closes with nobody deciding to close it. The migration that can be rolled back until the new service writes its first record in a shape the old schema rejects. The merger, until the first combined payroll. The new address, until the first piece of mail arrives there. The reorganization, until the first hire into the new chart. The currency changeover, until the first contract in the new unit. Lost: a capability, the old state's ability to take over from here. Carrier: the first write, performed by the new state in the ordinary course; not a decision about the reversal at all. Last keep: the expand-and-contract shape. Write to both for a season so the old can still read. The price is running two, and a season in which neither is the truth. Beside pivot-invariants, which name the retained assets that make leaving cheap: the moment one of them is lost. Beside undo-costs, which bills a reversal that remains possible: the reversal that stops being possible. Not Thawed to be ready, where readiness spoils the good; here the new state's use closes the way back to the old.

Kept on the machine. The option is held open by a device or an upkeep whose own running accumulates a harm, or whose lapse is one-way. The deadline is the machine's, not the situation's. The patient on ECMO as a bridge to transplant who becomes ineligible for the transplant the machine was keeping her alive for: bleeding, infection, and clotting rise with each week on circuit, and centres set a duration beyond which candidacy is reviewed. The mothballed mine kept dry by pumps whose stopping floods the workings past reopening. The ship in the reserve fleet whose hull is kept by cathodic protection that a budget line can end. The interim chief who has run the company past the point where the search can bring in an outsider. Lost: a capability, the eligibility or the workings. Carrier: the bridge itself, its complication rate or its upkeep bill. Last keep: a listing at the moment of cannulation. A search begun the day the interim was named. A decision to stop pumping taken while a sale was still possible. Each treats the bridge's start as the option's deadline. The ECMO limits are centre practice, simplified. Beside lead-time-floors' Bridge, a degraded replacement priced by the hour: the bridge that ends the option it holds open. Not Standstill with a term, where the clock is a date the counterparty signs; here the clock is a harm nobody signs.

Standstill with a term. A pause taken to keep an option open is written on a paper with a date. A situation that had no deadline acquires one. The paper's renewal belongs to the counterparty, who now knows what the pause is worth to the holder. The tolling agreement that stops the limitations clock the holder could have stopped alone by filing, and that expires in twelve months unless the adversary signs again. The negotiated leave that dates a job which had no date, extended only if the employer signs. The forbearance that holds the lender's foreclosure for ninety days. The furlough whose recall rights run six months. The takeover standstill that keeps the bidder from buying shares and ends on the day it says. Lost: permission, the leave to remain in the paused state. Carrier: the pause's own instrument, the only clock in the situation the holder wrote. Last keep: the renewal asked for before the counterparty learns it is needed. Or a pause written without a term, rarely granted; the Korean armistice has no renewal date and is still called temporary. The statutory pauses, the family-leave statute's twelve weeks and the restraining order's fourteen days, are the same date without the mechanism. The term is a rule's; the renewal belongs to a court or to no one; the holder gets the deadline without paying the counterparty for it. Those are runway-illusions' Stamp's clock. Beside impasse-inventions' cooling-off right, reversibility offered as a chip: the bill the chip carries. Not lead-time-floors' No-shop, which serializes the search; here the search is stopped, and the stopping is what expires.
